meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理“哪些主机目录可被 agent 容器访问”的允许清单：查看允许的目录及读写权限，添加新目录（先确认路径、询问只读或可读写），移除或清空条目并更新配置；新挂载自动用于新容器。
howto.when: 当你说到“mounts”、“mount allowlist”、“container mounts”等关键词，或要求查看/设置 agent 容器能访问哪些目录时触发。

say.text: 查看当前挂载允许列表
say.note: Claude 会读取配置并显示允许的目录及权限。

say.text: 把 /data 目录添加为只读挂载
say.note: Claude 会确认路径并更新允许列表。

say.text: 移除允许列表中的 /tmp 条目
say.note: Claude 会显示当前条目并确认后移除。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage the host-directory allowlist for agent containers: view allowed dirs and permissions, add dirs (verify existence, ask read-only/read-write), remove/clear entries, and update the config. New mounts apply automatically to new containers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", "container mounts", etc., or ask to view/configure which directories agent containers can access.

say_en.note: Claude will read the config and show allowed dirs with permissions.
Claude will verify the path and update the allowlist.
Claude will show current entries and remove it after confirmation.
